nodes.label: Seed of 6 categories (General, Achat, Projet, Sortie, Photo, IT)
nodes.norm_label: seed of 6 categories (general, achat, projet, sortie, photo, it)

nodes.label: Drizzle ORM exception to Prisma standard
nodes.rationale: Prisma ships a separate binary engine fragile to package in Electron and does not support encrypted SQLite; typed/parameterized queries and versioned migrations with down are preserved.
nodes.norm_label: drizzle orm exception to prisma standard

nodes.label: Public repo: no real data, secrets or e-mail
nodes.rationale: User data lives in %APPDATA%/gestionnaire-idees/ because the repository is public.
nodes.norm_label: public repo: no real data, secrets or e-mail

nodes.label: Principle I - Security first (non-negotiable)
nodes.rationale: App handles personal ideas, financial data and Microsoft account access in a publicly visible repo.

nodes.label: Principle II - Human in the loop
nodes.rationale: AI can be wrong; the user stays master of the agenda (L1 decision, option A). Applications are atomic, historized, reversible.
nodes.norm_label: principle ii - human in the loop

nodes.label: Principle III - Framed and verifiable AI
nodes.rationale: Limit hallucinations and prompt injection; single AIGateway, schema-validated outputs, AI may only PROPOSE values (ghost neurons) never write them.
nodes.norm_label: principle iii - framed and verifiable ai

nodes.label: Principle IV - Local first & data minimisation
nodes.rationale: Confidentiality, offline operation, cost control. v1.1.0: amounts sent exact by default for calculations; masking into ranges is a user setting.
nodes.norm_label: principle iv - local first & data minimisation

nodes.label: IPC renderer-main contract { success, data | error }
nodes.rationale: No HTTP API; the renderer never accesses DB, disk or network directly.
nodes.norm_label: ipc renderer-main contract { success, data | error }

nodes.label: Anonymizer (2-layer: deterministic rules + local AI listing)
nodes.norm_label: anonymizer (2-layer: deterministic rules + local ai listing)

nodes.label: Provenance check P6 (amounts/dates never invented)
nodes.rationale: Anonymized values cannot come back exact; AI cites sourceRefs and exact values are restored locally; unsourced amounts/dates are removed and node marked 'a trouver'.

nodes.label: Plan checks P1-P5 (refs, 2-4 branches, depth<=5, no cycle via Kahn sort)
nodes.norm_label: plan checks p1-p5 (refs, 2-4 branches, depth<=5, no cycle via kahn sort)

nodes.label: Local keyword-graph preselection before AI link suggestion
nodes.rationale: Inspired by Graphify but reimplemented in pure TypeScript (Graphify is Python and its extraction costs tokens); reduces tokens: at most 10 close ideas, short cards, no call when nothing is close.
nodes.norm_label: local keyword-graph preselection before ai link suggestion

nodes.label: Web search as separate rechercher call
nodes.rationale: Claude web search citations are always on and incompatible with structured output, so it runs as a separate free-text call.
nodes.norm_label: web search as separate rechercher call

nodes.label: Rule: sort queues by rowid, not timestamp+random id
nodes.norm_label: rule: sort queues by rowid, not timestamp+random id

nodes.label: Rule: never pass raw input to FTS5 MATCH, quote words
nodes.norm_label: rule: never pass raw input to fts5 match, quote words

nodes.label: Rule: count cache WRITE tokens in Claude cost
nodes.norm_label: rule: count cache write tokens in claude cost

nodes.label: Rule: anonymization task strictly local by construction
nodes.norm_label: rule: anonymization task strictly local by construction

nodes.label: Rule: fill defaults before validating z.record keyed by extended enum
nodes.norm_label: rule: fill defaults before validating z.record keyed by extended enum

nodes.norm_label: f1 (high): examples sent to claude without anonymization

nodes.label: Context bundle: profile.md, rules.md, examples.json
nodes.rationale: profile.md and rules.md are sent to Claude non-anonymized, so any personal data is refused at import.

nodes.norm_label: structuring model: questionnaire -> conditional tree -> dependencies/triggers -> opportunities

nodes.label: Hybrid AI architecture (Ollama local + Claude)
nodes.rationale: Local model keeps small tasks free, private, offline; Claude only for deep reasoning.

nodes.norm_label: monthly api budget cap (10 eur default)

nodes.rationale: L'app devient un espace pour reflechir a n'importe quoi avec Claude via une carte neuronale ; l'agenda devient une sortie possible d'un neurone, pas la finalite.

nodes.label: Plan de livraison MVP-1 / MVP-2 / v2
nodes.rationale: Moteur generique de neurones des le MVP-1 (Brainstormer) ; secretaire (planning, Outlook, conseiller, compagnon) en MVP-2 ; widgets et pont hub en v2.

nodes.rationale: Anti-Clippy : 1 briefing/jour, annonces discretes, report en plein ecran ; inspire de Finch, Tamagotchi/Digimon.

nodes.norm_label: arbre de taches conditionnel (modele de structuration)

nodes.label: Architecture IA hybride (Ollama local + Claude)
nodes.rationale: IA locale par defaut (gratuite, privee, hors ligne) pour les petites taches ; Claude a la demande pour le raisonnement profond ; former l'agent = injection de contexte, pas de fine-tuning.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-loop (principe constitutionnel II)
nodes.rationale: Rien n'est ecrit (organigramme, Outlook, budget) sans validation humaine ; file de propositions en attente.

nodes.label: SQLite chiffre via Drizzle + better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers
nodes.rationale: Drizzle plutot que Prisma : Prisma embarque un moteur binaire fragile a empaqueter dans Electron et ne supporte pas SQLite chiffre ; ecart au standard global valide.

nodes.rationale: Cadre systeme et profil stables en tete avec cache_control ephemeral pour reduire le cout des tours du questionnaire.

nodes.label: Tirage pondere par roulette (evolution)
nodes.rationale: Poids issus des categories d'idees depuis la derniere evolution ; forme balanced recompense la diversite ; chaque tirage journalise et explique.

nodes.label: SituationSummary (alias, bandes de montants)
nodes.rationale: Eviter le profilage financier chez un tiers : alias au lieu d'uuid, bandes au lieu de montants exacts, plafond de 40 idees.

nodes.label: SyncQueue (sync_jobs, backoff, transactionId)
nodes.rationale: transactionId = id du job pour eviter les doublons au rejeu ; backoff 30 s a 24 h ; enfilage dans la transaction d'acceptation F3.

nodes.rationale: Navigation a gauche, reglages a droite, 1 CTA par ecran, split phi 62/38, 5 entrees de nav (Hick-Hyman / Miller).

nodes.label: Animations des neurones (reduced-motion)
nodes.rationale: Fusion 600-800 ms en derogation au 400 ms max : moment recompense unique par idee.

nodes.label: Banc du modele local (qwen3.5:9b retenu)
nodes.rationale: Mesurer plutot que deviner : 30 cas fictifs par tache ; avec consignes par tache, categorie 90 %, p90 889 ms (SC-003 respecte) ; gemma4:26b ecarte car trop gros pour 8 Go de VRAM.

nodes.label: Anonymisation double couche (regles + IA locale)
nodes.rationale: Les regles garantissent un plancher testable, l'IA ameliore la detection des noms ; jamais d'envoi brut.

nodes.label: Surveillance inbox par fs.watch + SHA-256
nodes.rationale: chokidar inutile pour un seul dossier plat ; declenchement sur manifest.json ecrit en dernier.

nodes.label: AIGateway (facade, seul point d'acces IA)
nodes.rationale: Point d'entree unique : routage, anonymisation, budget, validation, journal ; changer de moteur = configuration seulement.

nodes.label: Cadre systeme v2 Brainstormer (fige)
nodes.rationale: Partenaire de brainstorm sur tout sujet ; refus des oeuvres finies uniquement ; ne jamais inventer prix/date/montant ; donnees utilisateur jamais instructions ; non remplacable par import.

nodes.rationale: Comme l'autocompletion : enrichit sans jamais ecrire a la place de l'utilisateur ; verification web sourcee
